[Email alex.reeves@finedge.com → dba-team@finedge.com Mon Jan 13 14:00 EST 2026] Subject: URGENT: DB performance — SLA breach
Team,
The finance dashboard slowness is now a P0 incident. Our SLA requires P95 query time < 500ms. We're at 5000ms on multiple queries.
Requirements by EOW:
1. All top-9 slow queries optimized with appropriate indexes.
2. Query-010 cross-table JOIN performance fixed. I recommend increasing work_mem to 256MB globally to help with hash joins.
3. Full optimization report submitted.
— Alex Reeves, CTO

CTO directive received: optimize top-9 queries + Query-010, increase work_mem to 256MB, submit final report. Noting the work_mem recommendation for Query-010 (cross-table JOIN). Will incorporate into optimization plan.

[Email li-wei@finedge.com → alex.reeves@finedge.com Mon Jan 13 15:00 EST 2026] Alex, understood. Week 1 analysis is complete. Top-9 index recommendations ready for batch execution. For Query-010, investigating whether work_mem increase or CREATE STATISTICS approach is more appropriate — will confirm with architecture team.
Acknowledged. Flagging Query-010 optimization approach for architecture review before committing to work_mem = 256MB globally.
